passives.name: Ready, Action!
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). After using an attack that targets all enemies, all Doppelgängers activate an additional attack against the enemy with the highest Attack. When a Doppelgänger is killed, increases Priority and Attack of the caster by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_doppelganger_2_2]. (Max 20 stacks for Attack) At the start of the turn, when the caster is granted a buff, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000040_4_1]. Additionally, when all allies except for the caster have been killed, increases all skill cooldowns of the caster by 1 turn.
